title: LULA I: Rollback-Resilient Hash-Based Signatures with Cache-Accelerated Signing
abstract: LULA is Ring0 Labs' research family of hash-based signature schemes. This first paper presents LULA I, a deterministic signer accelerated by reusable caches. For successfully generated keys and honest prepared, restored or absent caches, we prove reference-signer agreement on termination and returned signature bytes. An atomic rollback simulation transfers an applicable reference bound without signing-query loss; the complete reference-signer bound remains open. Signatures are 5,720 bytes; cache payload is approximately 72 MiB. On one host, prepared-signing medians were 3.56–3.64 ms across three message lengths. Three individual first signatures after cache loss took 330.049–337.563 s.
status: Mechanism-paper preprint prepared for submission; not submitted. Full reference-signer security remains open; public artifact deposit is pending.
